d: The church of Sant'Andrea della Valle. On the right the Attavanti chapel. On the left a palaced; on it a large painting covered by canvas. Various tools as a painter. A basket.
Sagrestano - Pupils and Singers of the chapel - Chierici - Confratelli.
The room of Scarpia on the upper floor of the Farnese palace. Table set. A large window towards the courtyard of the palace. It is night.
Spoletta and three cops introduce Mario Cavaradosi. Then Roberti, executor of justice, the IRS Judge with a Writer and Sciarrone.

The platform of Castel Sant'Angelo. On the left, a casamatta: there is a table, on which stand a lamp, a large register and the necessities to write: a bench, a chair. On a wall of the casamatta a crucifix: in front of this there is a lamp. On the right, the opening of a small staircase for which it ascends to the platform. At the bottom of the Vatican and St. Peter. Night - serene sky, sparkling with stars.
The Prisoner - Cavaradossi - A Sergeant - Soldiers.

In the meantime, a soldier's hand has come up from the ladder: an officer commands him, who deploys the soldiers in the bottom: follow Spoletta, the Sergeant, the Prisoner. - Spoletta gives the necessary instructions. The sky becomes brighter; it is dawn: they play at 4 in the morning.
